$meta.source: docs/game/SPEC.md sections 5.1, 5.2, 5.3, 6.3, 8, 9.1 (read-only here; this file is the pack's single source), amended by the house style owner order of 4 Nov 2026 (zero-chroma neutrals, the tight type scale, Geist, the 10 px radius, the 4 px grid, the house motion).
rules: one colour, one meaning: every served hex is listed once under color.* with its meaning; aliases point at a name, never repeat a hex
every hex that appears in served CSS, SVG or JS (every three.js Color argument included) is in color.* with served:true (A20 iv)
no colour exceeds 44% HSL saturation; nothing lighter than text-1; opacity always 1; every value is a fill, never a light (5.1)

state meanings: amber = alive or guard warn; the two stale greys = stale (and the dark grey is the dead body override); red = crit, breach, fault, dark, outage, dead rule; mustard = LIVE; text-2 = absence, hollow, manual (2.6)

base.use: page background (explicit on body), scene clear colour

seam.use: body and pad edge lines, grille slots, eye slit off

slab.use: floor slabs; the one repaired wall panel

slab-repaired.use: one repaired floor slab per bay

wall-seam.use: 1.5-unit panel seams on the rear wall

apron.use: the 0.12-wide apron border on every pad

text-1.use: figures, state words; the 2 px focus ring; the focused pad's edge lines

text-2.use: labels, ages, units; hollow outline parts, NO DATA floor outlines, the lock bar; MANUAL chip dotted outline; RECORDED and NO DATA glyphs

info-bar.use: 6 px left bar of an info alert row

pad-live.use: LIVE solid slab (Account 1) and LIVE CHAIN notched slab (Grok; meme desk when its mode word is live)

pad-shadow.use: SHADOW open frame: 12 thin box edges (ORB15, arena, meme desk unless live); held 1.5:1 against the synthetic stripe so the stripe reads on the frame

amber.use: eye slit filled; ALIVE glyph; chest plate 20 deg inner face; amber guard tiles; warn alert bar

stale-light.use: the light stripe of the 45 deg hatch: 3D texture, SVG pattern, plate band

stale-dark.meaning: stale or dead (hatch dark stripe; whole dead body)
stale-dark.use: the dark stripe of the hatch; the dead body override colour; the STALE glyph ground

red.meaning: crit, breach, fault, dark, outage, dead rule
red.use: chest plate 45 and 90 deg inner face; red tiles and blocks; DEAD glyph X; 2 px dead top rule; crit alert bar

crit-text.use: text only, always beside the word

mustard.use: LIVE chip solid fill (text in base); LIVE CHAIN chip 2 px outline with one notched corner, no fill

shadow-chip.use: SHADOW chip 2 px outline, no fill

synthetic.use: stripe on the pad; chip with 1 px outline

pulse.use: one flip of the indicator plate under prefers-reduced-motion (section 8)

sentinel-t0.use: ny > 0.5 faces; card left bar; glyph fill

sentinel-t2.meaning: Sentinel front, back and underside faces

sentry-t0.use: ny > 0.5 faces; card left bar; glyph fill

sentry-t2.meaning: Parked Sentry front, back and underside faces
sentry-t2.use: remaining faces, ny < -0.5 (the tipped hull's underside)

assembler-t0.use: ny > 0.5 faces; card left bar; glyph fill

assembler-t2.meaning: Assembler front, back and underside faces

orbiter-t0.use: ny > 0.5 faces; card left bar; glyph fill

orbiter-t1.meaning: Orbiter side faces; open slot plates

orbiter-t2.meaning: Orbiter front, back and underside faces; closed slot plates
orbiter-t2.use: remaining faces, ny < -0.5; the closed segment plates

brute-t0.use: ny > 0.5 faces; card left bar; glyph fill

brute-t2.meaning: Pedestal Brute front, back and underside faces

brute-plates-t2.meaning: Brute olive-brown plates, front, back and underside faces

walker-t2.meaning: Low Walker front, back and underside faces

family.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
family.sans: "Geist", "Geist Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

type.note: the house scale (owner order, 4 Nov 2026): a tight small-type scale in which only the stat value is big - stat 30 px (text-3xl) on a front plate, stat-compact 24 px (text-2xl) on a shelf plate and on the phone, meta 14 px, small and label 13 px, chip 12 px. Nothing above 14 px except a stat value.

space.note: the house density (owner order, 4 Nov 2026): every space is a multiple of 4; the grid gap is 8 px and the card padding 12 px, so a plate packs more facts per screen than the 12/14 it used. The row minimum and the touch target stay 44 px (a11y), the header stays 48 px (the stage-height rule in SPEC 5.3 counts on it).

motion.note: the house motion (owner order, 4 Nov 2026): a value that changes tweens from the last real value to the new one over 280 ms (never on mount, never extrapolated, never looped); a panel opens over 220 ms; a word morphs over 180 ms. All three are off under prefers-reduced-motion. The 3D scene timings above are unchanged.

radius.note: the house radius (owner order, 4 Nov 2026): 10 px is the base radius - cards, panels, chips, buttons; 8 px is the control radius for a small control inside a card. Nothing is square-cornered; a chip is 20 px tall with a 10 px radius, so it already reads as a pill.

elevation.note: shadows are for floating layers only (owner order, 4 Nov 2026): a popover, a dialog, a menu, a dragged card. A card, a plate, a panel, a row or the page never carries a shadow - the 1 px hairline does that separation. This token lives in tokens/house.css and not in the compiled stylesheet: the watchover surface has no floating layer, and A20 keeps the compiled CSS flat.
